title: POV: Jake Spends $14 Before 9 AM… You Spend $1 and Save $3,276 a Year 😳

lines: Jake hits snooze three times. He wakes up at eight fifty. Late. Again.
scenes.img: a young man in a blue shirt jumping out of bed in panic looking at a clock showing almost nine, messy bedroom, vertical composition

lines: No coffee, no breakfast. So he buys both on the way. Fourteen dollars.
scenes.img: a young man in a blue shirt running down a street holding an expensive latte and a breakfast sandwich, stressed face, vertical composition

lines: Every workday. That's about three thousand five hundred dollars a year!
scenes.img: a young man in a blue shirt standing next to a giant pile of paper coffee cups, shocked face, vertical composition

lines: You? Your phone charges across the room. So you have to get up.
scenes.img: {HERO} walking across a bedroom at dawn to switch off his phone alarm, smiling, vertical composition

lines: The coffee's already made. You set it up last night. Breakfast costs you one dollar.
scenes.img: {HERO} eating oatmeal with coffee at a sunny kitchen table, content face, vertical composition

lines: Then ten minutes with your bank app. You catch a forgotten fifteen dollar free trial.
scenes.img: {HERO} looking at his phone with raised eyebrows, a red warning icon floating above it, coffee mug, vertical composition

lines: Same job. Same paycheck. You keep three thousand two hundred seventy six dollars more.
scenes.img: {HERO} holding a big glass jar full of coins and bills, proud smile, vertical composition

lines: The whole morning routine, step by step? The full story is on my channel.
scenes.img: {HERO} waving at the viewer with a coffee mug in a cozy sunny kitchen, friendly smile, vertical composition
